scope: Visual review of canonical, quarter-loop and half-loop public frame samples across all five rarity tiers. Complete collection integrity is checked independently.
findings: Grayscale ASCII silhouettes remain readable across the sampled structural forms.
Common and higher-tier motion change native glyph or luminance cells; some periodic motions return to a matching half-loop pose.
All Legendary samples show formation or fragmentation transitions.
No blank, corrupt or visibly clipped sampled output requires a production repair.
